description: find_immutable_patch_key (email.rs:700-716) iterates over all patch keys and for each key iterates over all 23 IMMUTABLE_EMAIL_FIELDS entries. This is O(P×F) where P is the number of patch keys and F=23. For bulk keyword updates (e.g., a patch with 50 keyword entries), this is 50×23=1150 comparisons. A one-time LazyLock<HashSet<&str>> for the immutable fields would make the set lookup O(1) per key, reducing to O(P). The prefix check (starts_with + byte check) cannot be done with a plain HashSet, but the exact-match case can; the prefix case requires at most O(P) prefix comparisons regardless. Expected impact: measurable on accounts that batch many email updates.
title: find_immutable_patch_key is O(keys × fields); use HashSet instead
